final: WITH j AS (SELECT t.tradekind AS tk FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord r ON a.translink = r.transreg JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg), c AS (SELECT tk, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM j GROUP BY tk), s AS (SELECT tk, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.tk AS tradekind, s.cnt AS record_count, s.share AS share, s.share - av.avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM s, av WHERE av.avg_share IS NOT NULL AND s.share > av.avg_share ORDER BY s.share DESC
